messages:
jamie: Heads up — after the NCCL 2.18.3 rollout to a subset of A100 PCIe nodes (us-west2 + ap-south1) yesterday we're seeing intermittent multi-GPU inference jobs hang in the collective phase. CPU is idle, GPUs show no OOM, but progress stalls for 30-90s and sometimes recovers. Example pod: rt-infer-02-7f9c (k8s). Logs excerpt below.

jamie: ```
NCCL WARN Timeout 0 (rank 0 vs rank 1) waiting for 1 frames, last ptrs 0x7f3...
[2026-02-28 14:12:03] nccl-prims.cu:reduce_scatter: NCCL ERROR TIMEOUT
Backtrace: ...
```

deploy-bot: canary rollout for nccl=2.18.3 -> 100% completed on zone us-west2-canary (:rocket:)

kevin: Do we know the kernel/driver + pci link state on affected hosts? Can you run `nvidia-smi topo -m` and `dmesg | tail -n 100` on one of the stuck nodes? Also check `nvidia-smi -q -d P2P` for topology.

maria: Quick check shows pattern: us-west2 A100 PCIe nodes are on driver 535.86 and kernel 6.1.21; ap-south1 nodes have driver 535.86 but kernel 5.15.0 in some pools (weird). Dedicated pool infra/rt-a100-pcie-small had mixed kernel states due to a partial kernel roll earlier.

jamie: I reproduced locally on a 2xA100 PCIe machine with CUDA 12.1 + NCCL 2.18.3. Minimal repro (blocks at all_reduce):

jamie: ```python
# repro.py
import torch, torch.distributed as dist
dist.init_process_group('nccl', rank=0, world_size=2)
a = torch.ones(1024, device='cuda')
dist.all_reduce(a, op=dist.ReduceOp.SUM)
print('done')
```

jamie: With `NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=NVL` it stalls. Setting `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` or `NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=PAD` allows the job to complete consistently.

kevin: That suggests a P2P/PCIe interaction regression in 2.18.3. Quick mitigation: add `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` in the runtime container env for the canary allocation and watch error rate. If that reduces hangs, plan a targeted rollback of NCCL on the affected nodes.

natalie: Note: disabling P2P increases per-token latency ~15-25% on our batching profiles — cost goes up accordingly. For Dedicated customers this will materially shift throughput, so we should only force the change on affected nodes and keep a 5% traffic canary. We need a cost estimate in the ticket.

maria: I'll inventory kernels/drivers and pin the affected pool to a consistent kernel. If we can repro only on mixed-kernel pools, we might avoid a full NCCL rollback.

kevin: I'll stage a rollback plan: (1) set env `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` in runtime for the canary group; (2) if canary green for 1 hour, roll to 10% then 50%; (3) if still failing, pin nccl to 2.17.5 on the Dedicated image for the affected fleet and schedule a maintenance window.

jamie: I've also captured perf traces (nvprof + runtime logs) and attached to INF ticket. Repro times and metrics in the trace show stalls align with `ncclAllReduce` calls.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-2091: "nccl 2.18.3 P2P hangs on A100 PCIe — repro + mitigation" (assignee: kevin)

natalie: For prioritization: impact = medium (affects Dedicated A100 PCIe pools, intermittent but high tail latency), customer visible = yes for customers pinned to those pools. Recommend blocking full rollout in other regions until we confirm.

jamie: Blocking further rollout to other fleets for now. Will update INF-2091 with kernel/drivers list and perf deltas.

kevin: I'll prepare a small script to toggle `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE` via rollout API and patch the runtime config. Will post the patch link here when ready.

maria: I'll coordinate with infra ops to backfill the kernel on the odd nodes and rerun the repro.

jamie: Thanks all. If you see a stuck job, tag this thread + INF-2091 and include pod name + node.
